name: Handheld Vacuum Cleaner
definition: A compact portable household dry vacuum designed to be carried and operated as a self-contained hand unit with an integrated or removable battery and short-reach tools.
includedScope: Pet, upholstery, crevice and automotive-interior variants using documented dry-pickup tools
excludedScope: Stick vacuums used with floor wands and corded automotive vacuums
Workshop wet-dry vacuums and industrial dust extractors
Unverified batteries, chargers, filters, bins, brushes or tool compatibility
headline: Handheld vacuum batteries, bins, filters, tools and buyer checks
description: This profile separates battery, charger, air path, bin, filtration, nozzle and motorized tools so buyers can compare hand vacuums without treating voltage, runtime or maximum suction as a complete pickup result.
metaDescription: Handheld vacuum cleaner guide covering batteries, runtime, bins, filters, tools, models, standards and buyer checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not electrical, battery, allergy, automotive or hazardous-dust advice. Confirm the exact regional model, manual, charger, battery, filter, bin, tool, approved debris and surface before procurement or use.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.value: Portable self-contained dry vacuum operated as a hand unit
keyFacts.evidence: Official product pages identify compact cordless handheld vacuums with onboard bins and short-reach tools.
keyFacts.scope: Named dry-pickup hand vacuums; sticks and wet-dry workshop machines are excluded.

keyFacts.label: Performance boundary
keyFacts.value: Runtime, voltage and suction claims are source-method-specific
keyFacts.evidence: Manufacturers publish different battery, runtime, suction and tool configurations.
keyFacts.scope: Exact mode, tool, battery and test condition.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match battery, charger, bin, filter and tools by exact model
keyFacts.evidence: Official pages and manuals identify model-specific service parts and chargers.
keyFacts.scope: Exact regional model and serial family.

systemFlow.name: Energy storage and charging
systemFlow.componentFamily: Battery pack, protection electronics and charger
systemFlow.role: Supplies controlled DC power for the motor and powered tools.
systemFlow.evidence: Official sources describe integrated or removable cordless energy systems.

systemFlow.name: Air movement
systemFlow.role: Creates airflow and pressure difference through the selected nozzle or tool.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturer pages describe product-specific suction systems and modes.

systemFlow.name: Dirt separation and storage
systemFlow.role: Separates debris from the air stream and stores it for emptying.
systemFlow.evidence: Official product and parts pages identify bagless bins, separators and filters.

systemFlow.name: Task interface
systemFlow.componentFamily: Fixed nozzle, crevice tool, upholstery tool or powered pet brush
systemFlow.role: Presents the air path and optional agitation to the target surface.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturers list different model-specific tools and powered brushes.
systemFlow.scope: Delivered kit and written compatibility only.

variants.name: Fixed-nozzle hand vacuum
variants.taskScale: Quick crumbs and loose dry debris
variants.operatorRelationship: User carries the complete appliance and presents the onboard nozzle
variants.spaceConstraints: Nozzle reach, hand clearance and charging location
variants.limitations: Compact size does not establish suction or runtime.
variants.evidence: BLACK+DECKER and Shark publish self-contained fixed-nozzle formats.

variants.name: Pet-tool hand vacuum
variants.operatorRelationship: User connects a model-specific motorized or upholstery tool
variants.spaceConstraints: Tool depth, brush clearance and added hand load
variants.limitations: A pet label does not prove hair pickup on every textile.
variants.evidence: Shark and BISSELL document powered pet-tool configurations.

variants.name: Shared-battery compact vacuum
variants.taskScale: Household, vehicle or light workshop dry cleanup
variants.operatorRelationship: User installs a compatible platform battery and optional hose or extensions
variants.spaceConstraints: Battery mass, hose storage and charger footprint
variants.limitations: A platform name does not prove compatibility with every pack or charger.
variants.evidence: Hoover and Milwaukee publish removable-battery handheld systems.

performanceMetrics.name: Runtime
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Available pickup time before recharge or battery change
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Mode, tool, load, battery capacity, age and temperature affect the result
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Do not compare maximum runtime without matched conditions.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official pages publish model-specific runtime claims and qualifications.

performanceMetrics.name: Air performance or suction claim
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Units, inlet, tool, mode, filter condition and method differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Voltage, watts or a relative suction claim alone does not prove pickup.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Manufacturer claims use product-specific methods and baselines.

performanceMetrics.name: Bin capacity
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Potential debris volume between emptying events
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Nominal volume, practical fill line, debris bulk and separator state differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: A larger bin can increase carried mass and does not prevent filter loading.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Manufacturers publish exact-model bagless bin capacities.

performanceMetrics.name: Mass and reach
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Operator load during handheld and above-floor work
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Bare appliance, battery, tool and ready-to-use weights differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Catalogue mass does not establish grip or ergonomic suitability.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official pages publish configuration-specific weights and tool formats.

applicationFit.assessment: Trial representative debris with the exact nozzle and emptying cycle.

applicationFit.assessment: Use the intended textile and hair in a witnessed tool trial.
applicationFit.basis: Brush action, nozzle seal, fabric construction and hair type affect removal.
applicationFit.limitations: No zero-wrap or fabric-safety result is implied.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Check textile approval, pickup, brush cleaning and visible surface change.
applicationFit.evidence: Shark and BISSELL document motorized pet-tool use on upholstery.

applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Evaluate grip, tool retention, access and debris containment in the actual space.
applicationFit.assessment: Evaluate grip, tool retention, access and debris containment in the actual space.
applicationFit.basis: Body length, hose, crevice tool, battery mass and operator posture interact.
applicationFit.limitations: Portable positioning does not establish ergonomic suitability.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Trial intended users through the full reach and emptying cycle.
applicationFit.evidence: Official sources position selected models for car or above-floor tasks.
applicationFit.scope: Non-hazardous dry debris and approved surfaces.

componentStack.name: Battery and charger
componentStack.role: Store and restore energy for the exact appliance.
criticalChecks: Regional charger input and replacement availability
componentStack.evidence: Official sources identify model-specific energy systems.
componentStack.scope: No visual-fit or platform-name compatibility inference.

componentStack.name: Motor, fan and controller
componentStack.role: Generate and regulate airflow through the compact air path.
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturers publish different motor and control positioning.
componentStack.scope: Exact model; no normalized suction ranking.

componentStack.name: Bin and separator
componentStack.role: Separate and store dry debris before emptying.
componentStack.evidence: Official product pages describe exact-model bagless collection systems.

componentStack.name: Filter system
componentStack.role: Protect the motor and control exhaust within the documented design.
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturers publish product-specific filter architectures and parts.
componentStack.scope: No allergy or medical outcome is inferred.

componentStack.name: Nozzle and task tools
componentStack.role: Present airflow and optional agitation to the target area.
componentStack.evidence: Official pages list distinct tool packages for named models.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Pickup with the exact nozzle, debris and filter state
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by voltage, watts or relative suction alone
procurementDecisions.assessment: Run a matched debris and surface trial.
procurementDecisions.basis: Inlet geometry, airflow, filter loading and debris interact.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No single catalogue number establishes task performance.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Measure passes, escaped debris, filter loading and emptying time.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Confirm prohibited debris and filter instructions.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official sources publish different motor, nozzle and collection systems.
procurementDecisions.scope: Exact model and approved dry debris.

procurementDecisions.intendedTask: Clean upholstery, vehicles or above-floor areas
procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Tool reach, carried mass, grip and surface effect
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Treating low bare weight as ergonomic proof
procurementDecisions.assessment: Trial intended users through the full task and emptying cycle.
procurementDecisions.basis: Battery, body length, tool and posture determine operator load.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Catalogue dimensions do not establish safe reach.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Record task time, grip changes, tool retention and surface appearance.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Exclude sharp, hot, wet or hazardous debris.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Manufacturers document distinct portable and accessory configurations.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Battery, charger, filter, bin and tool availability
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming a family name guarantees all compatibility
procurementDecisions.assessment: Attach exact part numbers and replacement costs to the quote.
procurementDecisions.basis: Critical items are model and market specific.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain five-year part numbers, prices, lead times and warranty terms.
procurementDecisions.engineeringCheck: Verify charger region and battery storage or transport rules.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official product, parts and manuals identify exact service relationships.

engineeringChecks.reason: Incorrect packs or chargers can create performance and safety risks.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Match every battery and charger part number to the exact model manual and market.
engineeringChecks.evidence: IEC covers battery-operated household vacuums while manufacturers define exact systems.

engineeringChecks.reason: Leaks, loaded filters or damaged latches change airflow and containment.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Inspect seals and document filter cleaning, drying and replacement intervals.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official product and parts pages describe model-specific filtration and bins.
engineeringChecks.scope: No hazardous-dust or medical containment claim.

engineeringChecks.reason: Powered brushes, rigid nozzles and concentrated suction can affect textiles or finishes.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Obtain surface approval and trial the exact tool on a concealed representative area.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Manufacturers publish different crevice, upholstery and motorized tool packages.

standards.name: IEC 62885-2:2026
standards.applicability: Performance measurement methods for covered mains and cordless household dry vacuum cleaners.
standards.evidence: IEC publishes the scope and cordless measurement boundary.
standards.scope: Compare only values produced under matched methods and conditions.

standards.name: IEC 60335-2-2:2026
standards.applicability: Safety requirements for covered household vacuum cleaners, including battery-operated appliances and associated motorized heads.
standards.scope: Confirm regional adoption and exact product conformity.

developments.title: IEC 62885-2 third edition published
developments.summary: IEC consolidated current performance-method coverage for mains and cordless household dry vacuum cleaners.
developments.evidence: IEC records the publication date and scope.
developments.scope: International measurement standard; catalogue claims may use other methods.
